Historic 6-point Day today
2017-06-07T00:00:00+06:00 | Bss, Dhaka
https://www.thedailystar.net/city/historic-six-point-day-today-1416628

The historic 6-point Day, marking the demand for autonomy for former East Pakistan, now Bangladesh, will be observed today across the country in a befitting manner.

To mark the day, different socio-political organisations including Awami League, its associate bodies and like-minded socio-cultural organisations have drawn up elaborate programmes.

In separate messages, President Abdul Hamid and Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina paid their tributes.

In his message, President Hamid said, "The six-point demand was a milestone in the country's history..."

The prime minister, in her message, vowed to uphold the democratic rights of the people being imbued with the spirit of democratic movements and struggles including the historic June 7 in 1966.

On this day in 1966, Awami League (AL) under the leadership of Father of the Nation Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman called for a day-long hartal throughout East Pakistan pressing the demand for autonomy to end the exploitation, deprivation, subjugation and tyranny of the then central government of Pakistan on the people.

People took to the streets during the dawn-to-dusk hartal throughout the province and law enforcers opened fire on them at different places, killing at least 10 people, including labour leader Monu Miah, Shafique and Shamsul Huq, which intensified the movement further.

As a sequel to it, came the historic mass upsurge in 1969, and subsequently, the Liberation War in 1971.
